_comment: Unstructured DG0 on tetrahedra: a 12x12x12 simplex box of side 0.5 (PETSc's box mesher, via CTetgen; the half-size box gives the cells the optical and streaming weight of a unit box at n = 24 without the cost), S2, a pure absorber (sigma_t 2, no scattering, no source), 4 pi inflow on the left face, vacuum right, reflective y and z faces, under the OPT-IN Dirichlet-cell vacuum treatment. The regression file for the old simplex iteration creep: without the element-block scaling of PCAIR's pmat (-precon_block_scale 0) PCAIR's relative R drop discards the couplings next to the identity rows and the count at rtol 1e-12 climbs with refinement (6 here with the scaling, 12 without); see docs/dev/testing.md, 'Unstructured iteration counts'.
